description.value:
You summon stygian binding chains from the bleak realm of Gehenna to seize a creature you can see within range. The target must attempt a Will save. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained]{Restrained} by the chains, the target automatically fails Reflex saves against your spells and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard]{Off-Guard}. Sustaining this spell does not allow the target a new save — the chains simply persist. The target may attempt a new Will save against your spell DC at the end of each of its turns to break free.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Darkseeker's Restraint for 24 hours.

Success The target is not restrained, but is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed} by the chains for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape (against your spell DC) as part of a 2-action Escape attempt.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed} and takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed} by the chains, the target takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns; on a success it is freed.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained]{Restrained} (instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed}) and takes 6d8 bludgeoning damage immediately. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained]{Restrained}, the target takes 6d8 bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns; on a success it is only @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed]{Grabbed} (not restrained).

Heightened (+1) The initial and per-turn damage increase by 1d8.
